decisions.reason: The quantified customer savings evidence and strong fit with the firm's modular recycling systems mean the product's value has largely been validated, so management would keep this option open and is very unlikely to withdraw it now.

As a close-to-core machine that was given its own commercial presentation and faces no negative signal here, it remains sensible to keep it on the market while the firm continues learning about demand at limited incremental cost.

Because this multi-model line is presented as a flagship aligned with the firm's strategic direction toward modular cleaner generations, its strategic and option value remain too high for abandonment within the next year.

This screen still has the weakest visible validation among the older launches, but in a growing firm with related capabilities and low option-holding cost management would more likely preserve than abandon it for another year.

The new shredder line is close to the firm's established competence base and was launched with its own page and several models, so the prudent real-options choice is to keep it while early market feedback accumulates.

Although somewhat more exploratory than the shredder line, this multi-model screening range builds on existing processing know-how and should be retained because uncertainty is still resolving and the firm can afford to hold the option open.
